scope: Spain-facing Jackpot King near-cap research; no wagering authorization

crossMarketReferenceOnly.reason: UK-facing publications report these values, but operator/currency configuration may differ in Spain.

economicScreen.derivation: Under a uniform hidden-trigger hypothesis, with current pot P, cap C, house-edge h and target-pot meter allocation r, optimistic jackpot EV per EUR is approximately r*P/(C-P). Break-even requires P/C >= h/(h+r).
economicScreen.interpretation: The useful search zone is near the MBWB cap. Even under the most optimistic allocation assumption, a pot below about 92.2% of cap cannot clear a 4.5-point house-edge in this simplified model. With a three-way split, the optimistic threshold moves to about 97.3% of cap. These are research screens, not proven provider odds.

stakeImplication.ifProbabilityIsExactlyLinearInStake: Increasing stake increases absolute jackpot probability proportionally but does not improve jackpot EV per EUR. Minimum stake is therefore preferable for bankroll preservation while testing a fixed pot state, subject to exact operator rules.
